Packing your tool bag before your first salon day

Jessica Nguyen · Nov 5, 2026 · from NEXORA

Ask what the salon provides, list what to bring and pack for the services already discussed.

Before my first day, I asked which supplies were provided at the station and which services I would handle. I separated my packing list into personal tools and items needed only for practice sets.

I checked each item and gave it a fixed place in the bag. If something was missing, I asked ahead instead of trying to borrow it after arriving.

After the first day, I adjusted the list to the salon's workflow. The bag does not need to be full, but everything I agreed to bring should be easy to find and ready to use.
